title: [LOGGED OUT] Header links show a focus ring with the keyboard

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Press the Tab key until "Home" in the header has focus.
steps.saw: Tab pressed twice: first PRODUCT STORE, then Home (current) focused

steps.text: Is a clear focus ring shown around "Home"?
steps.saw: A blue rounded outline (rgb(0,95,204) auto 1px, :focus-visible true) is visible around Home
